Tig: text-mode interface for Git
=================================

What is Tig?
------------
Tig is an ncurses-based text-mode interface for git. It functions mainly
as a Git repository browser, but can also assist in staging changes for
commit at chunk level and act as a pager for output from various Git
commands.

Usage
-----

Basic usage examples:

	tig
	# Open Tig in the current repository

	tig log
	# Start in log view

	tig show
	# Open diff view

	tig blame <file>
	# Show file annotated by commits

	tig status
	# Start in status view

	tig grep <pattern>
	# Search for pattern in repository

	tig refs
	# Browse references (branches, tags)

	tig stash
	# Browse stash entries

	git show | tig
	# Use Tig as a pager

Views
-----

Tig presents various views of a repository:

- Main view: Shows a one line summary of each commit with author, date, and log message
- Log view: Presents a rich view of the revision log with full log message and diffstat
- Diff view: Shows the commit diff for the selected commit
- Blame view: Shows file annotated with commit information for each line
- Tree view: Shows the directory tree and file contents
- Refs view: Shows branches, tags, and other references
- Status view: Shows git-status output, allows staging/unstaging changes
- Stash view: Shows stash entries
- Grep view: Shows results from git-grep

Navigation
----------

- Arrow keys or k/j: Move up/down
- Enter: Open the selected item
- Tab: Switch between split views
- q: Close current view or quit
- h: Show help with all keybindings

Resources
---------

- Homepage: https://github.com/jonas/tig
- Manual: https://www.mankier.com/7/tigmanual
